headline: Duke Energy Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
summary: DUK beats Q2 2026 earnings estimates as operating income rises and utility customer growth continues, even though revenues are below expectations.

headline: Truist Securities Maintains Buy on CenterPoint Energy, Lowers Price Target to $46
summary: Truist Securities  analyst Richard Sunderland   maintains CenterPoint Energy (NYSE:CNP) with a Buy and lowers the price target from $48 to $46.
